mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.class_id, s.phone, s.address, s.create_time, c.class_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (student_no, name, gender, class_id, phone, address) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{classId}, #{phone}, #{address})
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET student_no = #{studentNo}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, class_id = #{classId}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE student SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_submission hs INNER JOIN homework h ON hs.homework_id = h.id AND h.is_deleted = 0 WHERE hs.student_id = #{studentId} AND hs.submit_status IN (1, 2) AND hs.score IS NULL AND hs.is_deleted = 0
